title: Synchronize Diagram Pan And Zoom
summary: Stripped kit.designs from kit_for_ui in _build_app_payload to reduce MCP payload from ~7MB to ~2.4MB. kit.designs (4.6MB) was redundant since the current design is already in payload.design, and mcpFlattenDesignForSemioSurface handles missing kit.designs via kit.designs??[]. kitArtifacts is built from the full kit before stripping so the kit browser panel still has all design entries. Rebuilt the MCP app HTML bundle.
